# Contributing

FolioDash is a draft. Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the [documentation map](../docs/README.md) first; the rules live there and are not repeated here.

- One branch and one coherent pull request per concern.
- Conform to [CleanStack](../docs/architecture/cleanstack.md) and the [decision register](../docs/architecture/decision-register.md), or amend them explicitly in the same pull request. Do not silently settle an open decision.
- Never commit real financial data, account identifiers, credentials or exports, even to a private branch.
- Commits are attributed only to approved humans listed in `.github/allowed-contributors.json`. The Contributor Attribution Policy check rejects AI or automation authors and co-authors.
- The licence is not chosen yet (FD-011), so external contributions cannot be accepted until it is.
